verdict.rationale: The only fit is the tax-registration questionnaire, which is filled in digitally and turned into an ELSTER XML document sent to the tax office. Incorporation requests also take structured company, shareholder and director details, implying generated founding documents. Nothing shows a general guided questionnaire library or any flagging of choices for attorney or notary review. Missing for 10: guided questionnaires across legal document templates, validation that documents are filled correctly, flagging of choices needing attorney review, independent or hands-on corroboration.
